input.title: OFF SHFT Logo Hat
input.descriptionHtml:
The O in OFF is a clock. The hands say 5:00.

Quitting time. The shift is done and the rest of the day is yours.

That's the whole idea, on the front of a hat. Wear it on the water, on the course, at the cottage or out by the boards.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Front: the OFF SHFT logo, embroidered, 62.6 mm (2.5 in) wide
  • Styles: Retro Trucker, 5-Panel, Dad Hat or Rope Cap
  • Retro Trucker: structured six-panel cap. Hard buckram front, mesh back, pre-curved visor, adjustable plastic snap closure
  • 5-Panel: structured mid-profile cap. One-piece front with no centre seam, 65% polyester and 35% cotton twill, adjustable plastic snap closure
  • Ships: made to order, usually ships in 2–5 business days

Fit questions? See Size & fit.
